games.name: One Thousand Rooms
games.desc:
⚠️ Game contains extremely loud noises, blood, and violence

The objective is in the title, go through one thousand rooms in one piece. Numerous entities with different behaviors are out for your blood.
If you aren't careful, you could be a threat to your own self.
Good luck, you will really, really need it if you want to come out alive.


❗THERE ARE NO CHECKPOINTS! AND THERE WILL NEVER BE! RESPECT THAT! This game is meant to be a more time-taking, challenging rooms game than other games. If you die, then it's okay, always make sure you have the time put aside if you want to beat the game. In the end, beating the game will be a reward and less of a chore if you don't force yourself to beat it. Have fun!

Main inspirations:
Elevation
Rooms but Doors
